nodes.description: Private constant invalid signer address; if the stored signer equals this address, relay reverts to disable the wallet.
Private constant storage slot used to store and load the wallet signer.
Mapping from intent id to receipt encoding canceled flag, relay block, and relayer address.
Internal pure library function that parses a signature and calls ecrecover.
Payable fallback function allowing the wallet to receive ether.
Payable initializer setting the signer once when no signer is stored.
View function returning the stored wallet signer.
View function returning the relayer address for a given intent id.
View function returning the block number when an intent was relayed.
View function returning whether an intent id has been canceled.
Payable function validating and executing a signed intent via delegatecall to a supplied implementation.
Cancels an unexecuted intent; restricted to calls originating from the wallet itself.
Internal pure function encoding canceled flag, block number, and relayer into a bytes32 receipt.
Internal pure function decoding a bytes32 receipt into canceled flag, block number, and relayer.
Pure ERC721 receiver hook returning the expected selector.
Untrusted caller address used for relay authorization and cancel restriction.
External delegatecall to a user-supplied implementation with user-supplied calldata.
Signature recovery primitive; signature malleability and validation concerns apply.
Inline assembly used for storage access, signature parsing, bit packing/unpacking, and revert forwarding.
Unchecked shift/or packing in _encodeReceipt can silently lose bits on oversized block values.
init has no caller restriction, so any account can initialize the wallet if signer is unset.
Parameter _signer of init; arbitrary signer address accepted during initialization.
Parameter _implementation of relay; arbitrary delegatecall target.
Parameter _data of relay; arbitrary calldata forwarded to delegatecall.
Parameter _signature of relay; signature used for ecrecover-based authorization.
Parameter _id of cancel; intent id to mark as canceled.
Parameter _hash of ecrecover2; signed message hash used in ecrecover.
Parameter _signature of ecrecover2; packed signature parsed into r, s, v.
Parameter _block of _encodeReceipt; block number shifted into the receipt.
Parameter _receipt of _decodeReceipt; packed receipt to decode.
Local id in relay computed from wallet, implementation, and data hash.
Local _signer in relay read from storage and used for authorization checks.

edges.reason: init accepts an arbitrary _signer and has no caller restriction, enabling front-run initialization.
_implementation controls the delegatecall target.
_data is arbitrary calldata executed via delegatecall in wallet context.
Local id derived from the intent is prepended to delegatecall calldata.
_signature is passed into ecrecover2/ecrecover for signer validation.
_hash is the signed message hash passed to ecrecover.
_signature is parsed into r, s, v for ecrecover.
_block is shifted left 160 and ORed without overflow or range check.
_receipt is decoded into canceled, block and relayer fields.
msg.sender must equal the stored signer or produce a valid signature to relay.
cancel requires msg.sender to be address(this), restricting cancellation to the wallet itself.
_id identifies the intent to cancel and cancellation is access controlled.
Local _signer read from storage is used for relay authorization.
INVALID_ADDRESS is checked to disable the wallet when the signer is invalid.
SIGNER_SLOT is used to store the signer in init.
SIGNER_SLOT is used to read the signer in signer.
intentReceipt is read and written in relay.
intentReceipt is read and written in cancel.
intentReceipt is read in relayedBy.
intentReceipt is read in relayedAt.
intentReceipt is read in isCanceled.
relay calls SigUtils.ecrecover2 for signature recovery.
relay reads msg.sender for signer authorization.
cancel reads msg.sender for the only-wallet restriction.
relay calls _encodeReceipt to store the intent receipt.
cancel calls _encodeReceipt to store the canceled receipt.
relayedBy calls _decodeReceipt.
relayedAt calls _decodeReceipt.
isCanceled calls _decodeReceipt.
relay calls _decodeReceipt when checking an existing receipt.
cancel calls _decodeReceipt when checking an existing receipt.
relay performs delegatecall to _implementation with appended id.
delegatecall can re-enter relay or other wallet functions in the wallet context.
init uses inline assembly for sload and sstore.
signer uses inline assembly for sload.
ecrecover2 uses inline assembly to parse the signature.
_encodeReceipt uses inline assembly for shl and or.
_decodeReceipt uses inline assembly for shr and and.
relay uses inline assembly to forward revert data.
ecrecover2 calls ecrecover.
relay validates the provided signature through ecrecover2/ecrecover.
relay writes the receipt using unchecked shift/or arithmetic in _encodeReceipt.
cancel writes the receipt using unchecked shift/or arithmetic in _encodeReceipt.
init lacks access control, allowing any caller to initialize the wallet.
msg.sender can call init before legitimate initialization if signer is unset.
relay checks that the stored signer is not INVALID_ADDRESS.
delegatecall to _implementation can modify intentReceipt through wallet storage context.
delegatecall can re-enter wallet code where msg.sender is the wallet itself.

Parameter _hash of ecrecover2 is the signed hash for ecrecover; merge into ecrecover unsafe operation.
Parameter _signature of ecrecover2 is parsed for ecrecover; merge into ecrecover unsafe operation.
Parameter _block of _encodeReceipt is shifted into receipt without overflow check; merge into _encodeReceipt arithmetic.
Parameter _receipt of _decodeReceipt is decoded into receipt fields; merge into _decodeReceipt function.
